clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope  —Manufacture of high alumina cement (HAC) and specific requirements for its use as a structural building material in the colder regions of our country (continuously 18°C and below). Its use as a refractory cement is not covered. NOTE — HAC mainly a refractory cement, but in some cold regions it may find use as a structural material due to high early strength development. Following restrictions shall be followed for its use in concrete— a) Shall not be used in locations where ambient temperature exceeds 180C. b) Accelerators like calcium chloride shall not be used. c) Steam curing or elevated temperature of  curing shall be avoided. d) Shall not be mixed with other types of  cement.

clauses.title: Total Alumina Content (Al2O3)
clauses.text: 2.1. Total Alumina Content (Al2O3) — Not less than 32 percent SUMMARY OF IS  6452 : 1989 HIGH ALUMINA CEMENT FOR STRUCTURAL USE (First Revision)

clauses.title: Fineness
clauses.text: 2.2 Fineness — Specific surface not less than 225 m2/kg

clauses.title: Soundness
clauses.text: 2.3 Soundness — Expansion not more than 5 mm (quantity of mixing water shall be 22 percent of cement by mass).

clauses.title: Setting Time
clauses.text: 2.4 Setting Time — Initial not less than 30 minutes and final not more than 10 hours.

clauses.title: Compressive Strength of Cement Mortar Cubes
clauses.text: 2.5 Compressive Strength of Cement Mortar Cubes 1:3 (1 cement: 3 Standard Sand ) by Weight: a) At 24 hours not less than 30 MPa 30 minutes b) At 72 1 hours     not less than 35 MPa

clauses.title: Delivery
clauses.text: 3. Delivery — Packed in specified bags of 50 kg or 25 kg net or in bulk with tolerances as given in  the standard. Note — For methods of tests, refer to relevant parts of  IS 4031 : Methods of physical tests for hydraulic  cement and IS 4032 :1985 Method of chemical analysis of hydraulic cement (first revision) For detailed information, refer to IS 6452:1989 Specification for High alumina cement for structural use (first revision). ± ±
